fusions.name: Ball and Shackle
fusions.desc: Casts a shackle weighted with a ball of stone at the first enemy it meets for 7 damage and leaves it [Leaden] for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Anchor Drop
fusions.desc: Drops a chained anchor of rock on an enemy for 32 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolted Down
fusions.desc: Locks plates of stone along your chains, raising your armour by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Rock Flail
fusions.desc: Conjures a flail of chain with a rock head: your weapon damage rises 14%, every strike leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage every 0.8 seconds, 3 times over, and your armour rises by 5%.
